```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(naniar)
library(table1)
dat_raw <- read.csv(here::here("P1/DataRaw", "hiv_6624_final.csv"))
```

# Glimpsing Data

Initial overview:
```{r}
summary(dat_raw)
glimpse(dat_raw)
```

Missing data:
```{r}
naniar::gg_miss_var(dat_raw)
naniar::vis_miss(dat_raw)
```

Table 1:
```{r}
table1(~ hard_drugs + hivpos + ART + everART + VLOAD + LEU3N + AGG_PHYS + AGG_MENT | years, dat_raw)
```
